briefing.headline: Jensen Huang is back as Nvidia CEO and president, and AI and chip stocks rallied across Asia and the US on the news.

points.text: Nvidia's board unanimously voted to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO and president, effective immediately. Huang returned to the office on Monday.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: Asian chip and AI stocks jumped. Taiwan stocks rose about 9% and South Korea's Kospi rose 5.8%, topping 5,000.
points.label: reported

points.text: Analysts are split on governance. One expert called the move a 'terrible mistake', while others say shareholder pressure drove it.
points.label: opinion

points.text: Nvidia's board and Trump's role are still open questions. US officials have also added Megaspeed and six other firms to a trade blacklist over export concerns.
points.label: reported

points.text: Analysts warn the rally may be a dead cat bounce. Some AI infrastructure stocks are still down more than 50%.
points.label: opinion
